note: tip_height is the Gate index-url tip clock, read fresh at receipt, bypassing the local mirror. A failed or stale read is not read and the state is held. A stale read is a tip answer not fetched from index-url for this receipt or retry: the local mirror, a cache, or an earlier read. The tip request is GET index-url/index. index-url is the one normative source. Extra index sources are optional and only ever raise the tip: a failed extra read is ignored, and a failed index-url read is not read. The check is decided once per client submission, at the first successful tip read with tip_height at or above last_beacon_height. Held retries and service-started re-verifies reuse it. A policy-version bump never revokes on it. A client resubmission is a new receipt. A lower tip after a reorg does not reopen a refuse. last_beacon_height is last_interrupt_height. tip_height minus last_beacon_height greater than K refuses. K is policy. A placeholder of 3 is placeholder, not ratified. A gap of 3 is not refused by this rule. A gap of 4 refuses as submission_deadline and is not a fake leg. When tip_height is below last_beacon_height the state is held, the read does not decide this rule, and each retry re-reads the tip. The section 15.3 held bound still applies and held_bound may refuse it. Tip-below and tip-not-read retries count toward reverify_max_attempts and are max_held_blocks causes.
